en.rec.duplicate-meta-description: Write a distinct description for each page, or leave it out so the engine writes one.
en.rec.duplicate-title: Give every page a unique title that names what the page is about.
en.rec.https-unavailable: Install a valid TLS certificate and serve the site over HTTPS, then redirect HTTP to HTTPS.
en.rec.js-dependent-content: Serve the main content in the initial HTML (server-side rendering or pre-rendering).
en.rec.page-status-4xx: Fix or redirect the broken URL, and remove internal links that point to it.
en.rec.page-status-5xx: Investigate the server error; a page that fails to load cannot be indexed.
en.rec.redirect-chain-long: Link directly to the final URL and redirect in a single step (301/308).
en.rec.schema-none-found: Add schema.org JSON-LD for the main entities of the site (Organization, WebSite and the page types you publish).
en.rec.slow-ttfb: Check server response time, caching and hosting; compare with field data before acting.
